source_rule: Original ballroom scene/plan/section determine visible motifs and arrangement. Reverse/hidden geometry and numerical module dimensions are proposals, not recovered facts.
name: Ballroom room and ceiling multi-view reference

views.name: Arrival facing north
views.requirement: Eye-level wide view toward north glazed focus and paired stairs, showing galleries and vault.

views.name: Reverse facing arrival
views.requirement: Opposed eye-level view looking south to the open arrival with visible corridor beyond; retain the SAME side galleries, columns, chandeliers and floor centre.

views.name: West wall elevation
views.requirement: Straight elevation of one full side gallery wall with four equal bays; show lower glazed bays, gallery support and upper tall glass. No perspective shortening.

views.name: Longitudinal section
views.requirement: 40m axial section showing gallery7m, vault springing16m and apex22m. Show thick supported wall/roof substrates, northern paired-stair route in side profile, real arrival opening.

views.name: Reflected ceiling plan
views.requirement: TRUE STRAIGHT-UP projection of the complete pointed rib-vault network, repeated star bosses, blue panels and chandelier attachment locations. NOT a top-down roof garden.

views.name: Ceiling oblique north
views.requirement: Upward oblique toward north revealing ribs, vault infills, lotus springings and chandelier suspension.

views.name: Ceiling oblique south
views.requirement: Opposed upward oblique toward south, same rib network, wall junctions and mounts as V05/V06.

views.name: Ground and gallery plan
views.requirement: Simple architectural top plan with chamfered room outline, central floor medallion, arrival, glazing marks, four side bays, paired stairs and gallery routes. Clearly distinguish solid wall, window and passage. This is a PROPOSED source-compatible plan, not measured.

layout_contract.units: metres, room scale independent of giant exterior multiplier

room_length_m.basis: drawn source plan annotation, not measured geometry

vault_apex_height_m.basis: drawn source section annotation, not measured geometry

layout_contract.plan_shape: elongated octagon: chamfered corners, continuous side galleries
layout_contract.orientation: arrival south; paired stairs and glazed focus at north
layout_contract.openings: South open arrival; side west/garden connections near arrival; north upper circulation toward throne room; central north stained-glass focus stays glazing, not a doorway
layout_contract.circulation: central clear dance floor, paired curved end stairs to gallery; no giant exterior scale furnishings
layout_contract.symmetry: bilateral room shell and paired stairs; no new whole-palace symmetry claim

prompt:
Edit the supplied ballroom reference SHEET in place, retaining its exact title, eight panel IDs, original palace palette (ivory/rose marble, gold, blue/lilac/rose glass), pointed vaulted room and all panel frames. This is a reference proposal, NOT measured architecture. Correct technical views without inventing a new room. Preserve V01 arrival, V02 reverse and V03 four-bay west elevation appearance.
V04 must become a REAL LONGITUDINAL SIDE SECTION through the SAME room, SOUTH LEFT and NORTH RIGHT, horizontal LENGTH40m displayed left to right. The room is20m wide out of this section. Do not draw an end wall front elevation or a centered arch as the side section. Draw four10m bays in succession along the horizontal cut: full continuous0m floor, left/south open arrival cut, right/north end glazing as an EDGE-ON vertical narrow wall cut. Gallery runs longitudinally at7m; vault springing16m, pointed vault apex22m. Black/grey cut poche for substrates, light profile drawing beyond. Northern curved stair shown as a SIDE PROFILE rising to7m, not two frontal stairs. Keep height arrows at right and horizontal40m arrow below. Draw repeated vault arcs along length, not one end-on giant arch.
V05: straight-up reflected ceiling projection. Show exactly FOUR10m vault bays along40m length, each with one star boss and chandelier mount on centreline, so FOUR chandelier fixtures total. Gold rib networks and blue star panels stay in each bay. No extra small hanging chandeliers along sides.
V06 north ceiling oblique must correspond to four-bay network looking toward north glazed focus, with four centreline fixtures. V07 is the OPPOSITE look toward south arrival: at far south end show the open arrival below a gallery/upper arch, not a duplicate of the north glazed focus. Preserve same vault surfaces and fixture sites as V05. Keep chandeliers readable with real chains/roses.
V08 retain two overhead plans, left ground and right gallery,40m north-south,20m east-west, chamfered corners, side bays and north paired stairs. Ground has the SAME northern stair positions and central floor medallion. Gallery at7m is ONLY a2.4m-wide perimeter band, connected north landing and the two stair upper endpoints. Middle MUST be an obvious open area labelled VOID TO BALLROOM BELOW with light grey dashed floor medallion well below; no solid upper-floor drawing or new central floor. South arrival remain open at ground and galleries continuous at sides.
Keep all views representing the same four-side-bay room; retain all sources/proposed footer. Print small '7/16/20m PROPOSED;40/22m SOURCE LABELS'. No red revision marks, extra scenes, new exterior building, plants covering technical views or cropped room plans. Exact title INT-BALLROOM-MV-001 — Ballroom coordinated room and ceiling views.

previous_attempts.prompt:
Create a high-resolution architectural reference sheet for the ORIGINAL PALACE BALLROOM shown in the ONLY supplied crop. Preserve ivory and rose veined marble, slender gold ribs/tracery, blue stained glass with lilac/rose lower accents, lotus capitals, star bosses, blue celestial vault infills, crystal chandeliers, rose planters, floor star medallion. This is NOT a redesign, new castle, bathroom, flat coffer room or hemisphere dome. Keep the POINTED RIB VAULT. Ornament is crisp, mechanically legible; no melted tracery, warped columns or fused supports. Quiet ivory sheet background, even light, thin ruled panels, legible names and exact IDs. No people. Show actual thickness and support, not floating ceiling decoration.
Title: INT-BALLROOM-MV-001 — Ballroom coordinated room and ceiling views. Exactly EIGHT panels on a landscape sheet,4 columns by2 rows. Each view has equal generous frame. No extra montage room or room-type alternatives.
One proposed coherent room: elongated octagonal/chamfer-corner plan, 40m long,20m width proposed,22m apex, galleries7m above floor, springing16m; four10m side bays per wall. South arrival, north focal blue stained-glass wall with paired curved side stairs rising to the north gallery; continuous west/east side galleries. One large blue/rose/gold star floor medallion centred under the main chandelier; keep central dance floor clear. Separate central glazed focus from passages beside it; don't draw doorway surrounds ending at a plain wall. West and garden terrace passages near arrival. All numeric widths/levels beyond source40m/22m are PROPOSED coordination values.

previous_attempts.rejection_reason: V04 is an end-facing view rather than a true longitudinal side cut; V08 gallery projection does not distinguish the central void; opposed ceiling views and fixture positions need coordinated revision.

review_notes: R02 corrects the longitudinal section and distinguishes gallery floor from central void. Opposed ceiling views now show north glazing versus south arrival.

Reference remains a coordinated design proposal, not proof of exact multi-view parity. Fixture/boss count and side-bay end treatment are not fully consistent across plans and perspectives; do not infer validated counts from the pixels. Normalize them to the layout contract during geometry planning.
The source labels40m length/22m height are inherited illustration labels, not measured facts. Proposed20m width/7m gallery/16m springing and four-bay scheme require review.
Dome interiors are not supplied by this pointed-vault ballroom sheet.
